dt: Step-1 proposal due Nov 20, 2026 (required); Step-2 proposal due Feb 5, 2027 (ROSES-25 Amendment 79)
e: New ROSES-2025 element funding investigations that prepare the two top-priority heliophysics spaceflight projects of the 2024 Decadal Survey: Links (magnetosphere-aurora coupling) and Solar Polar (global solar dynamics and the solar dynamo). Two-step submission with dual-anonymous review; NASA generally funds only US institutions, and non-US groups may take part without exchange of funds.
f: NASA Science Mission Directorate, Heliophysics Division
n: NASA ROSES-2025 B.8 Heliophysics Spaceflight Science Foundations (SSF)
unv: Award size and number of awards are in the full NSPIRES call text, which was not read; the amendment page and grants.gov notice do not state them.
